headline: SpaceX and Tesla boards explore potential multi-trillion dollar merger
summary: Boards for SpaceX and Tesla have started discussions regarding a potential merger, according to reports following a profit report from SpaceX.
why: Tesla is a prominent publicly traded electric vehicle and clean energy company, while SpaceX is a leading private aerospace manufacturer.

impacts.name: Tesla
impacts.why: Corporate consolidation discussions can create significant valuation shifts and strategic changes for listed entities.

why_moved: News of potential merger talks between two high-profile companies led by Elon Musk caught market attention and influenced trading sentiment.
